text:
Sasha: Quick sync — proposing a small funnel test tied to the micro-credential webinar. idea: give a 200-credit starter pack to attendees who complete a short prompt-template workshop. aim = lift 7-day activation and reduce time-to-first-success. thoughts?

Maya: Love it. would we gate credits on a small activation task (e.g., publish 1 prompt using the template) or just attendance? gating could help quality. :thinking_face:

Evan: Gated makes sense. we should make the task ~2min so friction stays low. also want to surface prompts in console templates—one-click import.

Priya: For measurement: primary metric = %users who hit >1k tokens in 7 days. secondary = retention at 14 days. plan to tag cohort = webinar_mcred_200_2026. will need tracking event: marketing.credit_claim and prompt.imported.

Sam: DevEx can add a workshop template pack and a CTA that does credit grant + onboarding modal. rough API usage: POST /v1/credits/grant { user_id, amount, reason }. we'll add a test flag.

Leo: Target segment = new signups in last 30 days + orgs <50 seats. we should also test a control arm that gets no credits but same workshop access. randomize at signup.

Maya: Messaging variations: A) "Get 200 credits to try our prompt templates" B) "Join workshop + claims 200 credits for hands-on" C) "Free credits when you ship your first prompt" — we should only run two at a time.

Priya: Sample size calc: expecting baseline 7-day activation 12%. to detect +3ppt lift with 80% power need ~4k per arm. can we fill that with webinar promos + inbound?

Sasha: We may not get 8k attendees. fallback: run as multi-week test across webinars + email nudge to recent signups. also boost conversion with paid promos if needed.

Sam: Implementation checklist (short):
- add template pack to Console (Sam)
- credit grant endpoint + feature flag (Sam/Eng)
- tracking events + cohort tag (Priya)
- landing copy + CTA variants (Maya)
- workshop 10-min script + slides (Sasha)
- A/B assignment logic for signup path (Evan)

Maya: Can someone create copy drafts by EOD Thurs? I can take variant A + B. Sasha take C.

Evan: I'll wire up the assignment rule in the signup flow and add a debug flag we can flip. will post the branch.

Priya: I'll stub the BigQuery tables and send the dashboard link when ready. will want daily cohort emails.

Leo: On routing: route inbound attendees who come from partner pages to the same cohort, but mark source=partner to measure lift separate.

Sasha: Ops-bot: schedule reminder for implementation standup Fri 9am.

ops-bot: Reminder set for Fri 09:00. Added calendar invite with attendees: Sasha, Maya, Sam, Evan, Priya, Leo.

Maya: Quick note on copy — emphasize "no card required" and the immediate ability to try templates. small trust wins.

Sam: FYI the grant endpoint will log request_id and return balance. will include sample snippet in PR description:
```
fetch('/v1/credits/grant', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({user_id, amount:200, reason:'webinar_mcred'})})
```

Priya: Also let's include an evaluation prompt set for quality monitoring so we can detect regressions tied to template usage. I'll add prompt-set id mcred_workshop_v1.

Sasha: Great. next steps: Maya + Sasha finish copy, Sam start Console pack, Evan wire experiments, Priya prep dashboard. Standup Fri 9 to confirm launch timeline. Thanks team :rocket:
